piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Family and close people
texto: Contextual reading about the family setting: when you read descriptions of homes, kinship ties are combined with places and states. Read the text noticing who is at home and how the family roles are distributed.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «คำเรียกเครือญาติในภาษาไทยมีความละเอียดและระบุฝ่ายพ่อหรือฝ่ายแม่อย่างชัดเจน» express?

opciones.texto: Thai kinship terms distinguish between the paternal and maternal side.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «คำเรียกเครือญาติในภาษาไทยมีความละเอียดและระบุฝ่ายพ่อหรือฝ่ายแม่อย่างชัดเจน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Introducing your family to new acquaintances strengthens mutual trust.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Gathering to eat as a family strengthens the bonds of affection.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the contextual reading, where is the father?

opciones.texto: At home with the mother (อยู่บ้านกับแม่)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the reading explicitly states «พ่ออยู่บ้านกับแม่».
Incorrect: the text says he is at home.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
